question: What is my total portfolio market value?
gold_sql:
WITH scoped_accounts AS (
                SELECT a.account_id
                FROM account a
                JOIN household h ON h.household_id = a.household_id
                WHERE h.advisor_id = ? AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
            ),
            latest_positions AS (
                SELECT p.account_id, p.instrument_id, p.mkt_value
                FROM position_hist p
                JOIN scoped_accounts s ON s.account_id = p.account_id
                WHERE p.as_of_dt = (
                    SELECT MAX(p2.as_of_dt)
                    FROM position_hist p2
                    WHERE p2.account_id = p.account_id
                )
            )
            SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(mkt_value), 0), 2)
            FROM latest_positions

question: What is my total unrealized P&L?
gold_sql:
WITH scoped_accounts AS (
                SELECT a.account_id
                FROM account a
                JOIN household h ON h.household_id = a.household_id
                WHERE h.advisor_id = ? AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
            ),
            latest_positions AS (
                SELECT p.account_id, p.instrument_id, p.qty, p.mkt_value
                FROM position_hist p
                JOIN scoped_accounts s ON s.account_id = p.account_id
                WHERE p.as_of_dt = (
                    SELECT MAX(p2.as_of_dt)
                    FROM position_hist p2
                    WHERE p2.account_id = p.account_id
                )
            ),
            open_lots AS (
                SELECT account_id, instrument_id,
                       SUM(qty) AS lot_qty,
                       SUM(cost_basis) AS cost_basis
                FROM tax_lot
                WHERE status = 'OPEN'
                GROUP BY account_id, instrument_id
            )
            SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.mkt_value - l.cost_basis), 2)
            FROM latest_positions p
            JOIN open_lots l
              ON l.account_id = p.account_id
             AND l.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
            WHERE ABS(p.qty - l.lot_qty) < 0.000001

            JOIN household h ON h.household_id = a.household_id
